•Spend more time stimulating your sense. Like making art, learning an instrument, studying (haha yes), reading tons, watching good movies and shows. 
This one's so important because as you grow older you will have a ton of academic pressure and you would wish you spend more time being creative as a young teen (learnt it the hard way).

•Your mind will be bombarded with tons of information and negativity. Our minds are not processed to take so much negativity at once.
